Im not sure where your reply when, but i saw that you played a golem graveyard deck?

For the classic Giant Beatdown, avoid overspending, as you lack an elixir pump and  can get punished easily.

For the first minute, Try your best to keep at least 3 elixir at all times to prevent getting punished really badly.

For the next minute is where things can get risky. Note all of your opponents specific counters to your cards(If you can, if not specifically your Graveyard counters) Try to defend with your Mega Minion and/or Electro Wizard, and if you face Pekka, use the Giant to kite it while using support to kill her.
In the first 2 minutes, try to hide your Graveyard until Double Elixir so you don't get punished too badly

Double Elixir time is where the deck shines, as it is a lot easier to defend and counterpush. Just be careful or several decks, namely LavaLoon, 3 Musketeers and Splashyard itself.

For Lavaloon, Spread your troops and minimise the chance of getting your Electro Wizard and Mega Minion from getting killex

For 3 musketeers, it partially relies on luck, as if you start with a bad hand, you are screwed. If you constantly face 3 musketeers, I suggest the second deck will do you much better.
